about: Country cards for lives born in Indonesia. Each card is dealt only to them (and a little more often than general cards). Sources are in each card's "src".

events.src: ===================== Indonesia (ID) ===================== Arisan: a monthly savings group where a name is drawn each meeting to take the pot (a common Indonesian practice). Risk ESTIMATE.

en..x: Your neighbourhood arisan meets every month: everyone pays the same amount, and a name is drawn to take the whole pot, until everyone has had a turn.

zh..x: 你们社区的阿里散每月聚会一次：大家交一样的钱，抽一个名字拿走全部会钱，直到每个人都拿过一次。

zht..x: 你們社區的阿里散每月聚會一次：大家交一樣的錢，抽一個名字拿走全部會錢，直到每個人都拿過一次。

events.src: THR: one month's wage for a full year of work, paid in full at least 7 days before Idul Fitri (Permenaker 6/2016; Minister of Manpower, via Setkab and Kontan).

en..x: Before Lebaran your employer must pay THR, a holiday allowance of one month’s wage, in full at least seven days before the holiday. Millions of people travel home for mudik.
en..mudik: Go home for mudik with gifts

zh..x: 开斋节前，雇主必须付宗教节日津贴（THR），相当于一个月的工资，而且至少要在节前七天全额付清。数以百万计的人返乡过节（mudik）。
zh..send: 寄一半回家，打电话问候

zht..x: 開齋節前，僱主必須付宗教節日津貼（THR），相當於一個月的薪水，而且至少要在節前七天全額付清。數以百萬計的人返鄉過節（mudik）。
zht..send: 寄一半回家，打電話問候

events.src: BPJS Kesehatan for independent members: Rp150,000 / 100,000 / 42,000 a person a month for classes I / II / III (class III subsidised to Rp35,000), Perpres 64/2020, still in force in Aug 2025 (LPEM; CNN Indonesia). Class I ≈ 0.056 and class III ≈ 0.013 a year of the game's typical wage (Rp32 million). Shares of bills covered are ESTIMATES.

en..x: As an independent worker you pay BPJS Kesehatan yourself: Rp150,000, Rp100,000 or Rp42,000 a person a month for class I, II or III (class III is subsidised down to Rp35,000).
en..k1.h: It pays about 80% of your medical bills.
en..k3.h: It pays about 65% of your medical bills.

zh..x: 自由职业者要自己缴国家医疗保险（BPJS Kesehatan）：一等、二等、三等每人每月分别是150,000、100,000和42,000印尼盾（三等有补贴，只需付35,000）。

zht..x: 自由職業者要自己繳國家醫療保險（BPJS Kesehatan）：一等、二等、三等每人每月分別是150,000、100,000和42,000印尼盾（三等有補貼，只需付35,000）。

events.src: Floods: Jakarta and other cities flood in many rainy seasons (BNPB). The chance that a flood or storm reaches you comes from EM-DAT (people affected a year, 2000–2024: js/data.js); premiums, damage and preparation costs are ESTIMATES.

en..x: Floods hit Jakarta and many other cities in heavy rainy seasons, and your street has flooded before.

zh..x: 雨季大雨时，雅加达和许多城市都会淹水，你住的那条街以前就淹过。

zht..x: 雨季大雨時，雅加達和許多城市都會淹水，你住的那條街以前就淹過。

events.src: Working abroad: under Law 18/2017 and BP2MI Regulation 9/2020, employers bear the placement costs for ten job types, including domestic and care work. Pay and housing multiples are ESTIMATES.

en..x: An agency offers a two-year job in Malaysia, Hong Kong or Taiwan at about {a} a year. Under the 2017 migrant-worker law, employers pay the placement costs for many jobs, so official agencies shouldn’t charge you a fee.

zh..x: 一家中介给你一份去马来西亚、香港或台湾的两年工作，年薪约{a}。根据2017年的移工法，很多工作的安置费由雇主负担，合法中介不应该向你收费。

zht..x: 一家中介給你一份去馬來西亞、香港或台灣的兩年工作，年薪約{a}。根據2017年的移工法，很多工作的安置費由僱主負擔，合法中介不應該向你收費。

events.src: FLPP subsidised mortgages: fixed 5% for up to 20 years, from 1% down, for first-time buyers under an income cap (about Rp8.5–14 million a month, PKP Ministerial Regulation 5/2025) and a price cap (about Rp166–185 million) (Kemenkeu; Kompas TV; Pasardana). With about 2.5% inflation, ≈ 2.5% real; a home at the price cap ≈ half of the game's family-home price.

opts.do: buyAt(P, { dp: .01, fee: .02, r: .025, n: 20, lk: 'trk.id_flpp', fixed: true }); T('id_far', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.commute') }); rec('id_far', .04 * base, 20)

en..x: FLPP subsidised mortgages charge a fixed 5% for up to 20 years, from 1% down, for first-time buyers below an income limit. Subsidised homes are usually on the edge of town; one costs {p}.
en..flpp.s: {d} up front, then {m} a year for 20 years, and about {c} a year in extra travel.
en..no: Your income is above the limit for subsidised homes.

zh..x: FLPP补贴房贷给收入在限额以下的首购族：首付最低1%，固定利率5%，最长20年。补贴房通常在城市边缘，一间要{p}。
zh..flpp.s: 首付{d}，之后每年{m}，供20年；每年还要多花约{c}的交通费。
zh..no: 你的收入超过补贴房的限额。

zht..x: FLPP補貼房貸給收入在限額以下的首購族：頭期款最低1%，固定利率5%，最長20年。補貼房通常在城市邊緣，一間要{p}。
zht..flpp.s: 頭期款{d}，之後每年{m}，繳20年；每年還要多花約{c}的交通費。
zht..no: 你的收入超過補貼房的限額。

events.src: Ride-hailing (ojol): driving in the evenings for Gojek or Grab. Earnings and wear are ESTIMATES.

opts.do: T('id_ojol', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.id_ojol') }); rec('id_ojol', -.25 * base, 4, -.6); happy -= 2

en..x: You could drive for a ride-hailing app (ojol) in the evenings and at weekends.
en..yes.s: About {a} a year after fuel. Long days: Happiness −2.
en..yes.h: Health −0.6 a year for four years.

zh..x: 你可以在晚上和周末开网约车或网约摩托（ojol）。
zh..yes.s: 扣掉油钱每年约{a}。整天很累：幸福感 −2。

zht..x: 你可以在晚上和週末開叫車服務的汽車或機車（ojol）。
zht..yes.s: 扣掉油錢每年約{a}。整天很累：幸福感 −2。

events.src: Retail government bonds: ORI027 paid 6.65% (3 years) and 6.75% (6 years), from Rp1 million, coupon tax 10% (Bisnis.com; Bareksa, Jan 2025). With inflation near 2.5%, about 3.5% real: an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Retail government bonds such as ORI027 paid 6.65–6.75% a year from Rp1 million, with 10% tax on the coupons. You have {a} to put somewhere.
en..ori.s: Move {a} in. About 3.5% a year after inflation.

zh..x: ORI027之类的零售国债年利率6.65–6.75%，100万印尼盾起买，利息税10%。你有{a}要找地方放。
zh..ori.s: 放入{a}。扣除通胀后每年约3.5%。

zht..x: ORI027之類的零售國債年利率6.65–6.75%，100萬印尼盾起買，利息稅10%。你有{a}要找地方放。
zht..ori.s: 放入{a}。扣除通膨後每年約3.5%。

events.src: JHT (Jaminan Hari Tua): 5.7% of wages a month, 3.7% from the employer and 2% from the worker (PP 46/2015); after leaving a job the whole balance can be taken in cash after a one-month wait (Permenaker 4/2022, from 26 Apr 2022, via CNN Indonesia and Tempo). The JHT fund earned 6.87% in 2024 (BPJS Ketenagakerjaan financial report, via Bisnis, Jul 2025), roughly 4% after inflation. The balance (taken as 7% of a year’s pay per year worked, with returns) and the smaller old-age income are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: cash += a; penM = (penM || 1) * (1 - .03 * n); penTk = 'id_jht'; T('id_jht', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.id_jht'), v: a, note: M('note.got', {a: MN(a)})})

en..x: You’re changing jobs. Your BPJS Ketenagakerjaan old-age savings (JHT) hold about {a}, and since 2022 you can take it all in cash a month after leaving.
en..keep.s: It keeps growing until you are 56.
en..keep.h: The fund has paid about 4% a year above inflation.
en..take.h: You will have less to live on in old age.
en..no: You haven’t paid in long enough.

zh..x: 你要换工作了。你在BPJS就业社保的养老储蓄（JHT）里大约有{a}，从2022年起，离职一个月后就能全部领现金。
zh..keep.h: 这笔基金扣除通胀后每年大约4%。
zh..take.h: 老了以后可用的钱会少一些。

zht..x: 你要換工作了。你在BPJS就業社保的養老儲蓄（JHT）裡大約有{a}，從2022年起，離職一個月後就能全部領現金。
zht..keep.h: 這筆基金扣除通膨後每年大約4%。
zht..take.h: 老了以後可用的錢會少一些。

events.src: KUR (Kredit Usaha Rakyat): government-subsidised small business loans at 6% a year (effective), micro loans up to Rp100 million, with collateral rules that vary by bank (Kemenko Perekonomian; BRI and Mandiri, 2025, via Bisnis and Kontan). Rp50 million ≈ 1.56 of the game’s typical wage; five years of repayments at 6% ≈ Rp11.9 million a year (0.37). A stall run by the family, its profit (about Rp13 million a year) and its odds are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: T('id_kur', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.id_kur')}); rec('id_kur', .37 * base, 5); T('id_warung', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.id_warung')}); rec('id_warung', -.4 * base, 12, -.3); happy += 1
pay(.3 * base); const tq = T('id_warung', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.id_warung')}); tq.v -= .3 * base; rec('id_warung', -.15 * base, 12, -.2)

en..x: Your family wants to open a warung in front of the house, with you as the backer. The bank offers a KUR loan at 6% a year.
en..kur: Borrow Rp50 million and open a proper warung
en..kur.s: A {a} loan, repaid at about {b} a year for five years.
en..kur.h: A good stall earns more than the repayments; some don’t last. Health a little lower each year from the extra work.
en..small.s: About {a} for a cart and stock.
en..no.s: Your money stays where it is.

zh..x: 家人想在家门口开一间小吃店（warung），由你出资。银行可以提供年利率6%的KUR贷款。
zh..kur: 借五千万印尼盾，好好开一间
zh..kur.s: 贷款{a}，五年里每年还大约{b}。
zh..kur.h: 生意好的话赚的比月供多；但有些撑不下去。多出来的活儿让健康每年少一点。

zht..x: 家人想在家門口開一間小吃店（warung），由你出資。銀行可以提供年利率6%的KUR貸款。
zht..kur: 借五千萬印尼盾，好好開一間
zht..kur.s: 貸款{a}，五年裡每年還大約{b}。
zht..kur.h: 生意好的話賺的比月付多；但有些撐不下去。多出來的活兒讓健康每年少一點。

events.src: ESTIMATE: game rule (many small food stalls struggle when a competitor opens nearby).

opts.do: if (roll('id_kur2') < .4) happy += 1; else { stopRec('id_warung'); pay(.1 * base); happy -= 3 }

en..x: A minimarket opened on the corner and the warung is barely covering its costs.
en..close.s: Any loan still has to be repaid.
en..push: Keep going with a new menu
en..push.s: More hours, a few more weeks of stock.
en..push.h: Fewer than half of struggling stalls recover.

zh..x: 街角开了一家便利商店，小吃店几乎不赚钱了。
zh..close.s: 如果有贷款，还是得继续还。
zh..push.s: 多花时间，多进几周的货。
zh..push.h: 撑不下去的店，能翻身的不到一半。

zht..x: 街角開了一家便利商店，小吃店幾乎不賺錢了。
zht..close.s: 如果有貸款，還是得繼續還。
zht..push.s: 多花時間，多進幾週的貨。
zht..push.h: 撐不下去的店，能翻身的不到一半。

events.src: Online loans (pinjol): OJK caps the interest on licensed consumer loans of under a year at 0.1% a day from 1 Jan 2026 (0.3% in 2024, 0.2% in 2025), with late fees capped at 100% of the loan (SEOJK 19/2023, via Bisnis and Investor Trust); unlicensed lenders charge far more and often harass borrowers and their contacts (OJK; Satgas PASTI). Rp3.2 million ≈ 0.1 of the game’s typical wage. Costs are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Your motorbike needs repairs and the rent is due. You need {a} before payday, and there is nothing in your account.
en..legal.s: Registered with OJK; interest capped by law.
en..illegal: The app from the text message
en..illegal.s: Money in ten minutes, no questions.
en..illegal.h: Unlicensed apps charge far more and read your contacts.

zh..x: 摩托车要修，房租也到期了。发薪前你需要{a}，可是户头里一毛钱都没有。
zh..legal.s: 在OJK登记；利息有法定上限。
zh..family.s: 有点尴尬，但他们帮了你。
zh..illegal.s: 十分钟到账，什么都不问。
zh..illegal.h: 无牌App收费高得多，还会读取你的通讯录。

zht..x: 機車要修，房租也到期了。發薪前你需要{a}，可是帳戶裡一毛錢都沒有。
zht..legal.s: 在OJK登記；利息有法定上限。
zht..family.s: 有點尷尬，但他們幫了你。
zht..illegal.s: 十分鐘到帳，什麼都不問。
zht..illegal.h: 無牌App收費高得多，還會讀取你的通訊錄。

events.src: Illegal online lenders are known for messaging borrowers’ contacts and employers; OJK and the police advise reporting them (OJK, Satgas PASTI). Amounts are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: The app says you owe double. Your friends and your boss are getting messages calling you a thief.
en..report: Report it to OJK and the police
en..report.s: Explain to your friends what happened.
en..report.h: Happiness −2 and some embarrassment; the messages stop.
en..pay.h: Happiness −2. Paying often brings new demands.

zh..t: 通讯录里的人都收到讯息
zh..x: App说你欠的钱翻了一倍。你的朋友和老板都收到讯息，说你是小偷。
zh..report.s: 跟朋友解释发生了什么。
zh..report.h: 幸福感 −2，有点丢脸；讯息停了。
zh..pay.h: 幸福感 −2。付了常常会被要更多。

zht..t: 通訊錄裡的人都收到訊息
zht..x: App說你欠的錢翻了一倍。你的朋友和老闆都收到訊息，說你是小偷。
zht..report.s: 跟朋友解釋發生了什麼。
zht..report.h: 幸福感 −2，有點丟臉；訊息停了。
zht..pay.h: 幸福感 −2。付了常常會被要更多。

events.src: Online gambling (judi online, judol) is illegal in Indonesia; PPATK estimated about 8.8 million players by Q3 2024 (3.4 million in 2023), most betting under Rp100,000 at a time, with Rp43 trillion deposited and Rp283 trillion of turnover (PPATK, via Bisnis and Kontan, Nov–Dec 2024). Rp1 million ≈ 0.03 of the game’s typical wage. Odds and amounts are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: A friend shows you a slot game on his phone that he says is “gacor” right now: he turned Rp100,000 into Rp2 million last night.
en..try.h: These games are built so players lose over time.

zh..x: 朋友给你看他手机上的老虎机游戏，说现在“很会出”：他昨晚把十万印尼盾变成了两百万。
zh..try.h: 这种游戏的设计就是玩家迟早会输。

zht..x: 朋友給你看他手機上的老虎機遊戲，說現在「很會出」：他昨晚把十萬印尼盾變成了兩百萬。
zht..try.h: 這種遊戲的設計就是玩家遲早會輸。

events.src: ESTIMATE: game rule (people who chase gambling losses usually lose more).

en..x: You’ve lost more than you meant to. The app sends you a bonus code: “Your luck is about to turn.”
en..more: Top up and win it back
en..more.h: Happiness −3. Chasing losses almost always ends in bigger losses.
en..stop: Delete the app and tell someone

zh..x: 你输的比原本打算的多。App传来一个奖励码：“你要转运了。”
zh..more.h: 幸福感 −3。追输的钱几乎都会输得更多。

zht..x: 你輸的比原本打算的多。App傳來一個獎勵碼：「你要轉運了。」
zht..more.h: 幸福感 −3。追輸的錢幾乎都會輸得更多。

events.src: Regular Hajj: registering takes a Rp25 million deposit per person, unchanged since 2010; those registering in 2025 wait from about 17 years (Gorontalo) to 34 years (Aceh), with a national quota of about 221,000 (Kemenag, via Kontan, 2025); pilgrims paid on average Rp55.4 million in 2025, about 62% of the full cost (Kemenag, via NU Online). Umrah packages cost about Rp30–40 million a person (travel agents, 2025: ESTIMATE). Rp50 million ≈ 1.56, two umrah trips (Rp70 million) ≈ 2.2 of the game’s typical wage.

en..x: Your parents have long dreamed of the Hajj. The waiting list in your province is about twenty years.
en..reg.s: Rp25 million each, {a} for both, to join the queue.
en..reg.h: The wait can be longer than parents have.
en..umrah.s: About {a} for the two of them.
en..later.s: Maybe when you have more saved.

zh..x: 爸妈一直梦想去麦加朝觐。你们省的排队名单大约要等二十年。
zh..reg.s: 每人两千五百万印尼盾，两人共{a}，开始排队。
zh..reg.h: 等待的时间可能比父母剩下的岁月还长。

zht..x: 爸媽一直夢想去麥加朝覲。你們省的排隊名單大約要等二十年。
zht..reg.s: 每人兩千五百萬印尼盾，兩人共{a}，開始排隊。
zht..reg.h: 等待的時間可能比父母剩下的歲月還長。

events.src: When a registered pilgrim’s turn comes, the balance of the cost is due; if the pilgrim has died, the seat can pass to a child or the deposit can be refunded (Kemenag rules on pelimpahan porsi). Balance (Rp60 million for two) ≈ 1.9 of the game’s typical wage; amounts are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: A letter from the Ministry of Religious Affairs: the seats you paid for years ago are ready this season.
en..go: Pay the balance and send them

zh..x: 宗教部来信：你多年前缴订金的名额，今年轮到了。

zht..x: 宗教部來信：你多年前繳訂金的名額，今年輪到了。

events.src: CPNS 2024: 250,407 civil-service posts (114,706 central, 135,701 regional) and over 2 million registrants by 2 Sep 2024 (MenPAN-RB; BKN, via Kompas TV and Bisnis), roughly one place for every eight. Civil servants rarely lose their jobs and get a pension. The chance of passing (12%), the pay and pension effects and the course fee (Rp1.6 million ≈ 0.05) are an ESTIMATE.

later.id_cpns: if (roll('id_cpns') < .12) { bump('id_cpns', .9, M('trk.id_cpns')); layM = (layM || 1) * .1; penM = (penM || 1) * 1.3; happy += 4; log(M('log.id_cpnsOk'), 'good') } else log(M('log.id_cpnsNo'), 'bad')

en..x: Your parents want you to sit the CPNS civil-service exam. A government job means security for life, they say.
en..try: Take a prep course and sit the exam
en..try.s: About {a} for the course, and your evenings.
en..try.h: Only about one in eight applicants gets a post. Those who do earn a little less, but almost never lose their job, and get a better pension.
en.log.id_cpnsOk: You passed the CPNS exam and start as a civil servant.
en.log.id_cpnsNo: You didn’t pass the CPNS exam this year.

zh..x: 爸妈希望你去考CPNS公务员。他们说，铁饭碗一辈子都安稳。
zh..try.s: 补习费大约{a}，晚上都要读书。
zh..try.h: 大约八个人只有一个考上。考上的人薪水稍低，但几乎不会失业，退休金也比较好。
zh.log.id_cpnsOk: 你考上CPNS，开始当公务员了。

zht..x: 爸媽希望你去考CPNS公務員。他們說，鐵飯碗一輩子都安穩。
zht..try.s: 補習費大約{a}，晚上都要讀書。
zht..try.h: 大約八個人只有一個考上。考上的人薪水稍低，但幾乎不會失業，退休金也比較好。
zht.log.id_cpnsOk: 你考上CPNS，開始當公務員了。

events.src: Millions of workers commute into Jakarta every day from Bogor, Depok, Tangerang and Bekasi by KRL train, bus and motorbike (BPS Jabodetabek Commuter Survey, 2019). Rent for a kos room near the office versus a house further out, and the health and happiness effects of long commutes, are an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: T('id_kos', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.id_kos')}); rec('id_kos', .12 * base, 5, .3); happy += 2
T('id_kos', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.id_far')}); rec('id_kos', -.06 * base, 5, -.5); happy -= 2

en..t: Near the office, or far away?
en..x: Your commute takes an hour each way. You could rent a kos room near the office, or move further out where rent is cheaper.
en..kos.s: About {a} a year more in rent.
en..kos.h: Happiness +2 and a little more Health: two hours a day back.
en..far.s: About {a} a year less in rent, and a long train ride.
en..far.h: Happiness −2, Health a little lower each year.
en.trk.id_far: Rent saved by living further out

zh..t: 住公司附近，还是住远一点？
zh..x: 你通勤单程要一小时。可以在公司附近租个套房（kos），也可以搬到更远、房租更便宜的地方。
zh..kos.h: 幸福感 +2，健康稍微好一点：每天多出两小时。
zh..far.s: 房租每年少大约{a}，但要坐很久的火车。
zh..far.h: 幸福感 −2，健康每年少一点。

zht..t: 住公司附近，還是住遠一點？
zht..x: 你通勤單程要一小時。可以在公司附近租個套房（kos），也可以搬到更遠、房租更便宜的地方。
zht..kos.h: 幸福感 +2，健康稍微好一點：每天多出兩小時。
zht..far.s: 房租每年少大約{a}，但要坐很久的火車。
zht..far.h: 幸福感 −2，健康每年少一點。

events.src: Indonesians bought about 6.3 million motorbikes in 2024, mostly on credit from finance companies (AISI). A Rp20 million motorbike ≈ 0.62 of the game’s typical wage; a small down payment (Rp1 million) and three years of instalments come to about Rp30 million in all (finance company tables, 2025: ESTIMATE).

opts.do: pay(.03 * base); T('id_motor', {kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.id_motor')}); rec('id_motor', .3 * base, 3); happy += 2

en..x: Everyone at work rides to the office. A dealer offers a new motorbike with a Rp1 million down payment.
en..credit.s: {a} down, then about {b} a year for three years.
en..credit.h: Happiness +2; you pay about half as much again as the cash price.

zh..x: 同事都骑车上班。车行说新摩托车只要一百万印尼盾头期款就能骑走。
zh..credit.s: 头期款{a}，然后三年里每年大约{b}。
zh..credit.h: 幸福感 +2；总共多付大约一半的车价。

zht..x: 同事都騎車上班。車行說新機車只要一百萬印尼盾頭期款就能騎走。
zht..credit.s: 頭期款{a}，然後三年裡每年大約{b}。
zht..credit.h: 幸福感 +2；總共多付大約一半的車價。

events.src: BPJS Ketenagakerjaan for workers without an employer (BPU): work-accident (JKK) and death (JKM) cover from Rp16,800 a month (PP 44/2015), about Rp200,000 a year ≈ 0.006 of the game’s typical wage; JKK pays treatment for work accidents and cash for lost days. The share of bills it saves is an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: T('id_bpu', {kind: 'ghost', label: M('trk.id_bpu')}); rec('id_bpu', .006 * base, 30); medCut = (medCut || 1) * .9

en..x: Working for yourself, nobody covers you if you get hurt on the job. BPJS Ketenagakerjaan offers accident and death cover from Rp16,800 a month.
en..join.h: Covers treatment and lost days after a work accident.
en..no.h: Accident bills would be yours alone.

zh..x: 自己做的话，工作受伤没人保障。BPJS就业社保有意外和身故保障，每月一万六千八百印尼盾起。
zh..join.h: 工作意外的医疗费和休息期间的收入都有保障。

zht..x: 自己做的話，工作受傷沒人保障。BPJS就業社保有意外和身故保障，每月一萬六千八百印尼盾起。
zht..join.h: 工作意外的醫療費和休息期間的收入都有保障。

events.src: Land certificates: since 2017 the PTSL programme registers land and issues certificates free of the main fees, village by village (ATR/BPN); land without a certificate is more often disputed, and brokers (calo) charge to speed things up. The fee and dispute odds are an ESTIMATE.

en..x: Your parents’ land in the village has never had a certificate, only an old letter from the village head. This year the PTSL programme is registering land in their village for free.
en..ptsl.s: Free, with several trips home and long queues.
en..ptsl.h: Happiness −1 from the hassle; the land is safe.
en..calo: Pay a broker to handle it
en..leave.s: Everyone in the village knows it’s theirs.
en..leave.h: Land without a certificate is more often disputed.
en.trk.id_calo: A broker for the land certificate

zh..x: 爸妈在村里的地一直没有地契，只有村长写的一封旧信。今年PTSL计划在他们村免费登记土地。
zh..ptsl.s: 免费，但要回去好几趟，排很久的队。
zh..ptsl.h: 麻烦一点，幸福感 −1；土地有了保障。
zh..leave.s: 村里人都知道那是他们的地。
zh..leave.h: 没有地契的土地比较容易起纠纷。

zht..x: 爸媽在村裡的地一直沒有地契，只有村長寫的一封舊信。今年PTSL計畫在他們村免費登記土地。
zht..ptsl.s: 免費，但要回去好幾趟，排很久的隊。
zht..ptsl.h: 麻煩一點，幸福感 −1；土地有了保障。
zht..leave.s: 村裡人都知道那是他們的地。
zht..leave.h: 沒有地契的土地比較容易起糾紛。

events.src: Land disputes over uncertified plots are common and slow to resolve in court (ATR/BPN; Mahkamah Agung case statistics). Amounts are an ESTIMATE; famSpent lowers what your parents leave you.

en..x: A neighbour’s son has a certificate for part of your parents’ land, issued when nobody was looking.
en..court.h: Happiness −3. More than half win, but losing costs the whole plot.
en..give.s: Keep the peace in the village.
en..give.h: Happiness −2; your parents will have less to leave you.
en.trk.id_tanah: Legal fees for a land dispute

zh..x: 邻居的儿子拿出一张地契，上面有你爸妈的一部分地，是趁没人注意时办的。
zh..court.h: 幸福感 −3。一半以上会赢，但输了整块地都没了。
zh..give.h: 幸福感 −2；爸妈能留给你的会变少。

zht..x: 鄰居的兒子拿出一張地契，上面有你爸媽的一部分地，是趁沒人注意時辦的。
zht..court.h: 幸福感 −3。一半以上會贏，但輸了整塊地都沒了。
zht..give.h: 幸福感 −2；爸媽能留給你的會變少。
